title: 第十二章 盟庭大典第十一章 三年一瞬
content_zh:
深秋霜降，天朗气清。
三年一度的武林盟庭大典，在晨钟声中拉开了帷幕。
中原盟殿前的广场上，车马排了整整数里。
从山脚到殿门，各色旌旗在秋风中猎猎翻卷。
形形色色江湖人挤满了石阶，有须发皆白的门派长老，有腰佩长剑的年轻高手，有披金戴银的富豪商贾，也有粗布麻衣的游侠散人。
三教九流，无一缺漏。
大殿之内，位次森严。
正中高台，蓝婷端坐在盟主尊位上。
一身素白锦袍，衬得她面容清冷，眉眼之间没有半分锐气，只有一派温顺恭谨。
远远看去，就像一尊摆在高处的玉器，好看，但没有分量。
侧首偏位，坐着上官复。
他穿了一身墨色锦袍，腰束玉带，气度雍容。
目光扫过阶下群雄时，带着一种天生的傲然。那是掌权者看蝼蚁的眼神。
他不遮掩，也不觉得需要遮掩。
大典的流程按部就班地推进。
先是各派朝拜，接着是献礼，然后宣誓效忠盟规，最后是议事。
每一步都规规整整，像一台上了发条的铜钟，精确无误。
到了盟主致辞的环节，蓝婷缓缓起身。
她走到高台中央，向四方微微欠身，开口说话时声音不大，带着几分小心，几分怯意。
“三年以来，江湖安定，各派和睦共处。

这一切，皆赖上官大人居中制衡，鼎力扶持。婷儿资质浅薄，德不配位，幸得大人庇护，才得以固守虚名。
往后必当恪守规制，尽心辅佐上官大人，共护江湖太平。”
这一番话，把自己说得一无是处，把功劳全推给了上官复。
没有半分傲气，没有半分野心，就像一个听话的木偶，在台上的每一句话都是别人替她写好的。
阶下群雄纷纷拱手，应和声此起彼伏。
“上官大人劳苦功高！”
“江湖三年安定，全是大人一力支撑！”
“盟主谦虚了！”
话虽恭敬，可所有人的目光都绕过高台上的蓝婷，落向侧位的上官复。
在他们眼里，那个温顺的素白身影，不过是一件摆设，一个替上官复挡骂名的棋子。
大典进行到中段，议事环节开始。
一个偏远门派的掌门壮着胆子站起来，拱手行礼。
content_en:
Frost has fallen in late autumn, and the sky is clear and clear.
The triennial martial arts alliance ceremony kicked off with the sound of morning bells.
In the square in front of the Zhongyuan League Hall, carriages and horses lined up for several miles.
From the foot of the mountain to the gate of the palace, flags of various colors are fluttering in the autumn wind.
People from all walks of life crowded the stone steps, including elders of sects with white beards and hair, young masters with long swords on their waists, rich merchants wearing gold and silver, and knights and knights in coarse linen.
There are three teachings and nine streams, without any defects.
Inside the main hall, there is a strict order of things.
In the middle of the high platform, Lan Ting sat on the alliance leader's throne.
Wearing a plain white brocade robe, she had a cold face. There was no sharpness between her eyebrows and eyes, only meekness and respect.
From a distance, it looks like a jade placed high up, beautiful but without weight.
With his head tilted sideways, Shangguan Fu sat down.
He wore a dark brocade robe and a jade belt around his waist, looking graceful and graceful.
When he glanced at the heroes below the steps, there was a kind of natural pride. That's the way those in power look at ants.
He doesn't hide, nor does he feel the need to hide.
The ceremony progressed step by step.
First, each faction made a pilgrimage, then offered gifts, then swore allegiance to the alliance's rules, and finally discussed matters.
Every step is as precise as a clockwork clock.
When it came time for the alliance leader to make a speech, Lan Ting slowly stood up.
She walked to the center of the high platform, bowed slightly in all directions, and spoke in a low voice, with a bit of caution and a bit of timidity.
“In the past three years, the world has been stable and all factions have coexisted harmoniously.
All of this relies on the checks and balances of Lord Shangguan and his full support. Ting'er's qualifications are shallow and her virtue is not worthy of her position. Fortunately, thanks to the protection of adults, she is able to stick to her false reputation.
From now on, you must strictly abide by the rules, assist Sir Shangguan with all your heart, and protect the peace of the world. "
With these words, he made himself worthless and put all the credit on Shangguan Fu.
There is no arrogance or ambition. She is like an obedient puppet. Every word she says on stage is written for her by others.
The heroes at the foot of the stairs raised their hands and cheered one after another.
"Master Shangguan, your hard work has paid off!"
"The three years of stability in the world are all due to the support of adults!"
"The leader is humble!"
Although the words were respectful, everyone's eyes bypassed Lan Ting on the high platform and fell to Shangguan Fu on the side.
In their eyes, that meek and plain white figure was just a decoration, a chess piece used to block Shangguan's reputation.
In the middle of the ceremony, the discussion began.
The head of a remote sect had the courage to stand up and salute with his hands in hand.
